svg.text: Nextflow_Genotype_Pipeline · nine modules, run end-to-end or individually
PLINK (bed/bim/fam) or VCF from multiple arrays, platforms, batches
Per-sample, batch or chromosome-split layouts, auto-detected
Mixed hg19 / hg38 builds; a sample sheet drives discovery
Reference genomes, chain files, genetic maps, TOPMed PASS sites
GRAF-anc data; 1KG-HGDP reference panel for local ancestry
Sample discovery and format conversion (VCF ↔ PLINK)
Reference alignment and hg19 → hg38 liftover (CrossMap)
Platform-level UNION merge; light QC (call rate, duplicates, monomorphic)
Any or all services per platform; runs kept separate until QC
MagicalRsq-X ancestry-aware quality filter (not a fixed R² cut-off)
Per-platform, per-server QC reports; performance by MAF bin
INTERSECTION merge after imputation (shared variants only)
Multi-allelic resolution; variant tracking across every step
Re-impute the merged set to fill gaps introduced by intersection
Same servers and automation as Module 2
Second-pass MagicalRsq-X; HWE, MAF, heterozygosity, sex check
Relatedness (GENESIS PC-Relate or PLINK kinship) and PCA
Outputs: MAF-filtered set for GWAS, unfiltered set for ancestry
Global: GRAF-anc (8 major groups + subgroups); ADMIXTURE K = 2–12
Local: RFMix v2 (default), FLARE, G-NOMIX or RFMix v1 vs 1KG-HGDP
PCA / ADMIXTURE plots; QC and imputation metrics by ancestry
Imputed genotypes vs WGS truth: concordance, R², retention by MAF
Six QC / merge strategies (A–F) × three imputation servers
GCTA phenotype simulation with ancestry- and tract-specific effects
GWAS power, hit recovery and local-ancestry accuracy by ancestry
Illustrative outputs: values are schematic, not results
PLINK / VCF · global ancestry calls · local ancestry tracts · QC & benchmark reports
Nextflow_GWAS_pipeline · subworkflows toggled on or off by parameters
Analysis-ready genotypes from Panel A (PLINK 1/2, BGEN or VCF)
Phenotypes and covariates; binary, quantitative or time-to-event
Global ancestry calls and local ancestry tracts (or infer here)
Optional kinship matrix / GRM for related samples
PLINK2 QC: MAF, HWE, variant and sample missingness
GRAF-anc (default), ADMIXTURE or PCA when calls are not supplied
Stratify: EUR, AFR, EAS, SAS, AMR, MID, AAC, AHI, LAT1 / LAT2
Minimum n per group; ancestry × trait combinations run in parallel
REGENIE (default), SAIGE, BOLT-LMM, PLINK2 or GENESIS mixed models
SPA-Cox survival GWAS; significance filtering and LD clumping
env-MR-MEGA for categorical covariates (e.g. tumour subtype)
Merged, annotated summary statistics per trait
Alternatives: SuSiE, FINEMAP, CAVIAR; 95% credible sets per locus
MAGMA gene / set / cell type; FUMA
LAVA local rg; FLAMES gene prioritisation
Manhattan, QQ, Miami, regional, forest and PRS plots; λGC
Ancestry-comparison plots: h², PRS performance, colocalization heatmaps
MultiQC and an HTML pipeline report per run
summary statistics · credible sets · PRS weights · h² / rg · colocalized QTLs
Every module is an independent Nextflow DSL2 entry point: run end-to-end, resume from any module, or run one module on existing outputs.
Containerized (Apptainer / Singularity / Docker); HPC / SLURM ready.
